name: orybit
description: The software layer for physical objects.

scripts.check:protocol: npm run build:protocol && npm run test:protocol
scripts.check:api: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:api && npm run test:api
scripts.check: npm run check:foundation && npm run check:protocol && npm run check:api
scripts.cf:d1:create: npx wrangler@4 d1 create orybit-registry --binding DB --update-config --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:local: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply orybit-registry --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:remote: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply orybit-registry --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
